results.title: Content Bibliothek
unknowns: Exact numeric eligibility thresholds in E1 remain to be reconciled
SPM does not own an existing bilingual enterprise learning-content SaaS library
results.why: The title was misleadingly scored as software development. The live procurement is for an existing SaaS digital learning-content library for approximately 16,000 licensed employees, including a large German/English on-demand catalogue, REST/OpenAPI integration, Microsoft Entra ID SSO, accessibility and recurring content updates. Turnover disclosures and references are required. This is a vendor/reseller route, not a lean custom-build opportunity.

results.title: IZIKO RFQ R-E 26/04/2026 – Graphic design and layout of Nelson Mandela Prison House exhibition
unknowns: SPM does not currently evidence South African CSD/tax/B-BBEE compliance or local exhibition-delivery references

results.why: The creative scope itself is lean and attractive: graphic design/layout of approved exhibition content with print-ready output over roughly 12 weeks. But the RFQ requires South African supplier compliance documents including CSD registration, tax-status PIN and B-BBEE evidence, and a minimum functionality threshold applies. This is a good local-partner/white-label opportunity, not a direct Belgian-company GREEN.

results.title: COJ0001-26/27 – Transcription, Translation, Interpretation, Sign Language and Braille Services
unknowns: Exact pricing volumes and all returnable compliance documents require final RFQ review
results.why: Transcription alone looked highly lean, but the actual RFQ bundles transcription with translation, live interpretation, South African Sign Language and Braille, including onsite delivery as required. The bidder must be on the Johannesburg supplier database and affiliated with a professional body; local tax/B-BBEE/CSD documentation is also material. A specialised local language-services prime is required.
